pilot_scope: Research-only metadata reconciliation and adapter design; no production RF or inventory change.
entry_gates: Obtain and archive the exact versioned source metadata, license, README, dictionary, and checksums.
Resolve raw ARFCN/base downlink/frequency units and carrier direction against authoritative source documentation.
Resolve the transmit-power reference plane and obtain absolute antenna gain/pattern or explicitly narrow the claim to relative/quantity validation.
Define deterministic NCI/ECI/cell mapping including the 342 currently unmapped rows.
Document receiver height, device/instrument, calibration, detection floor, aggregation, missingness, and route/session semantics.
Confirm that the intended processing and derived artifacts are permitted by the data license.

responsibilities: Read only the approved source version and fail closed on unresolved semantics.
Emit the existing concept-6a validation schema without changing the canonical RF evaluator.
Preserve raw source fields and field-level provenance in adapter artifacts.
Reject silent defaults, unparseable station configuration, unmapped serving identities, and unresolved frequency/power units.
non_responsibilities: No optimizer or radio-quality policy changes
No replacement of canonical antenna patterns
No changes to production inventory schema

expected_source_to_validation_mapping.acceptance: Deterministic join with coverage report and explicit unmapped rows.
WGS84 and accuracy retained; no grid-cell replacement.
Exact quantities only; no received-power/path-loss substitution.
Mapping remains blocked until unit/epoch/direction reconciliation passes.
Coordinate and zero-height policy explicitly reported.
Reference frame and sign convention documented.
Power reference plane and bandwidth semantics established; otherwise preserve as source-only fields.

validation_sequence.gate: version, license, checksums, file inventory, and small-sample reproducibility
all required units and field semantics resolve without defaults
serving mapping coverage, duplicate identities, and unmapped rows are explicit
metric definitions, device/calibration, censoring, aggregation, and spatial accuracy are explicit
run existing evaluator in validation mode with 2.6/N78 or other resolved frequency only; report exact quantity and residual
site/route/time holdouts and no calibration leakage
only after all 6A/6A.1 blockers and the existing 6B gate are independently satisfied

invariance_requirements: canonical RF evaluator and profile defaults remain unchanged
inventory semantics and normal-planning defaults remain unchanged
scenario and interference fingerprints remain stable for existing fixtures
optimizer and radio-quality policy remain unchanged
terrain remains disabled for the canonical urban_short_range path
research_sub_thz and 140 GHz references remain unchanged
